notes.title: Music update!
notes.content:
[b][i]Let the notes guide you![/i][/b]

Since many of you don't like the silence I've added some tunes during the gameplay.
Make sure to leave your feedback!
If you want your song in Ink. or just want to send me some song you like, please hit me at [url=https://twitter.com/cla8194]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: UI improvements
notes.content: A small update on UI elements that should improve your initial experience with the game. I'm currently still working on more updates like this mostly based on your feedbacks, thank you.

notes.title: Minor update & announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
This is a small patch to fix some UI visibility and text.

In the next few days I'm going to work on more UI improvements and a more clear tutorial for new players.
Any type of feedback or questions is highly appreciated!
